# Get all contacts with relationship "coworker" and "friend" from phone app
phone_token = phone_login['access_token']
venmo_token = venmo_login['access_token']

def get_all_contacts(relationship):
    all_contacts = []
    page_index = 0
    page_limit = 20
    while True:
        contacts = apis.phone.search_contacts(
            access_token=phone_token,
            relationship=relationship,
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit
        )
        if not contacts:
            break
        all_contacts.extend(contacts)
        if len(contacts) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return all_contacts

print(f"Number of friends: {len(friends)}")
